description: A child recovering from sustained harm at school, where rest matters more than academics.

leaving_behind: a school that dismissed repeated bullying reports
daily pressure to perform in front of peers
adults who did not believe my child
wants_to_add: unhurried time to rest and recover
small experiences of feeling capable again
trust that learning will return on its own
intake.additional_context: The family expects the first months to focus on recovery rather than academic progress and wants suggestions that will not feel like another demand.
